C0034.title: Scalper Registers Thousands of Accounts to Scalp Moutai
C0034.summary: In February 2022, a scalper used 1,000 real-name accounts to bulk-buy Moutai during store reservation sales, securing 126 bottles. By posting a campus 'part-time job' to collect ID numbers and phone numbers, students paid upfront and resold the bottles, netting the scalper at least 150,000 yuan.
